Former Jama Masjid Imam Appears in Court Over 2007 Case

Syed Ahmed Bukhari, the former Shahi Imam of Delhi's Jama Masjid, appeared before a court in Muzaffarnagar. The appearance relates to a case dating back to 2007 concerning alleged violations of the election code. Bukhari was granted bail in the matter.
